Fine. The manual, since nobody read it in 1985 either.

TYPE SHORT COMMANDS, like a telegram:
  LOOK (L)            see the room again
  EXAMINE <thing>     study something closely (X)
  TAKE / DROP <thing> carry it, or don't
  SEARCH <thing>      poke around inside and behind
  OPEN <thing>        lids, boxes, doors of the small kind
  INVENTORY (I)       what's in your pockets
  GO <direction>      NORTH, UP, DOWN, or a door's name
  USE <a> WITH <b>    two things, one bad idea
  PLAY, INSERT, PRESS, DIAL...  gadgets have their own verbs
  HINT                a nudge, in three levels, each stronger
  HELP                this screen

The toolbar has mute, effects and text size. Every sound is also written out, so you lose nothing on mute. Keys work too: Alt+M, Alt+E, Alt+Plus, Alt+Minus.

When in doubt: LOOK, then EXAMINE everything. Yes, everything.
